source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Apply mainly to pregnancies already identified as high-risk from the start, rather than to the broader general perinatal population as a whole","B":"Take the place of the individualized clinical judgment a provider would otherwise exercise at the bedside, rather than support that judgment","C":"Provide evidence-based, standardized approaches to common perinatal complications, shown to improve maternal outcomes when consistently implemented","D":"Rest on a fairly limited body of supporting research evidence for actually improving maternal outcomes when implemented over time"}}
source_row.rationale: Standardized perinatal safety bundles provide evidence-based, standardized approaches to common perinatal complications, shown to improve maternal outcomes when consistently implemented, applicable across risk levels.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose and Evidence for Safety Bundles
